findings.evidence: tests/phase-6b-d110c-0c1a-retirement-checkpoint-red.test.ts:53 (`readOutboxPage: () => Promise.resolve(input.rows)` ignores afterKey/limit, so the MAXIMUM_DURABLE_ISSUANCE_PAGE_LIMIT clamp and afterKey advancement in packages/node/src/internal/creator-issuance-retirement-boundary.ts:89-96 are never exercised across pages); creator-issuance-retirement-boundary.ts:130 (`lineage.next <= admitted` is unreachable given the invariant enforced at line 97-99)
